structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身已经是高度符号化的吉祥物图形，具备清晰的几何轮廓。根据 theme_rules，当主体为清晰物体轮廓时应保留其拓扑结构。因此，不需要像游戏类 App 那样重构为抽象徽章，而是直接对现有的鲨鱼图形进行‘去色、加粗描边、扁平化’的风格迁移，保留其作为 IP 的完整性。
preserve: 鲨鱼头部的特定几何剪影（头顶三角鳍和背部曲线）
张开的大嘴与锯齿状牙齿的形态
圆润夸张的眼睛位置及瞳孔朝向
火箭位于嘴部的基本空间关系
must_preserve: 鲨鱼头部的整体外轮廓走向
嘴巴张开的角度和牙齿的尖锐锯齿特征
眼睛在头部的位置比例
鲨鱼与火箭的组合逻辑（不可分离）
recompose_allowed: 将原本的橙色渐变背景替换为纯黑
将复杂的阴影和高光简化为纯色块
将平滑的矢量边缘转化为抖动的手绘线条
调整火箭和火焰的颜色以适配主题色板
restyle: 应用粗犷的黑色手绘描边
使用蜡笔/马克笔质感的平涂填充
去除所有立体光影效果
色彩映射为主题限定的高饱和红/蓝/黄/白
forbid: 保留原本的橙色渐变背景
使用灰色或低饱和度颜色填充主体
保留细腻的光影渲染和高光点
描边过细或过于规整平滑
将鲨鱼简化为普通鱼类或海豚
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle style icon of Douyu shark head with rocket in mouth. Pure black background. Thick, rough, uneven black marker outlines. Flat solid colors: creamy white/yellow body, deep red mouth/rocket, blue accents. No gradients, no shadows, no 3D effects. Naive, clumsy, cute aesthetic. Centered composition.
color_application: Map original orange/white/grey scheme to theme palette: Shark body becomes creamy white or light yellow; Mouth interior and Rocket become deep red/brick red; Accents (if any) become deep blue. All fills are flat, high-saturation, no gradients.
stroke_application: Replace original clean vector lines with thick, irregular, hand-drawn black strokes. Edges should look like crayon or marker marks, slightly shaky and rounded, not sharp or perfect.
composition_application: Center the simplified shark head and rocket combination. Remove all background elements. Ensure subject occupies 60-70% of the canvas against the pure black void. Maintain the relative position of the rocket in the mouth.
identity_application: Preserve the unique triangular dorsal fin, jagged teeth, and round eye placement to ensure immediate recognition as Douyu's mascot. Do not abstract into generic shapes; keep the specific character silhouette intact but stylistically flattened.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough, hand-drawn style outlines
Colors must be limited to high-saturation Red, Blue, Yellow/White
No gradients, shadows, or realistic textures allowed
Subject must be flat geometric blocks
negative_constraints: No thin or smooth vector lines
Do not change the shark into a generic fish or remove the rocket
